paper.title: Multi-Scale Optimization of the Design of Offshore Wind Farms

queries: exact title plus code and data
Davide Cazzaro multi-scale offshore wind farm code
public_source_search.target_result: No paper-linked target implementation or machine-readable UK instance was located.

cited_predecessor.title: Variable Neighborhood Search for Large Offshore Wind Farm Layout Optimization
cited_predecessor.use: official NREL-15MW, RVO wind, fixed-wake, depth/foundation, legal offshore candidate and cited VNS completion authority

paper_contribution.problem: wind farm area selection problem joining macro location screening, meso area and shape construction, and micro turbine placement
paper_contribution.primary_novelty: new meso-scale constructive shape heuristic and first integrated macro-meso-micro framework
paper_contribution.objective: maximize 25-year discounted NPV from energy revenue less CAPEX and OPEX
decision_scales: macro: local cell, rectangle orientation and side ratio
meso: iterative turbine placement and resulting convex-hull shape
micro: discrete turbine positions inside the fixed shape
constraints: 100 NREL 15 MW turbines and at most 1.5 GW
perimeter divided by square root of area at most 5
one connected shape contained in a bidding region
at least 7 km from existing, planned and restricted areas

physics_and_economics.wake: Jensen within and from nearby wind farms up to 60 km
physics_and_economics.wind: five years of hourly ERA5 data at 0.25 degrees
physics_and_economics.turbine: NREL 15 MW with full power and thrust curves

target_method.macro: 3 by 3 local 0.0625-degree-equivalent cells, six orientations and five side ratios; every rectangle contains 100 regularly targeted turbines mapped to legal candidates
target_method.meso: place the first turbine at the seed and repeatedly choose the highest partial-NPV legal candidate in the union of 15-kilometre disks; before every ordered commit retain enough mutually compatible positions from the feasible macro reserve to prove 100-turbine completion; shape is the final convex hull
target_method.meso_objective: energy and foundation terms plus explicit PtA, density and area penalties; export and inter-array terms are constant during construction as stated by the paper
target_method.micro: cited Basic VNS completion with 3D, 5D and 8D neighborhoods, counter-keyed random-conic shake, 128 one-opt candidates and incumbent retention
target_method.comparison: apply equal micro optimizer and time limit to the constructed shape and best macro rectangle

missing_information_and_declared_complet.completion: reconstruct the paper equations and cited VNS with counter-keyed events and publish every output layout

missing_information_and_declared_complet.field: UK polygons, restrictions, existing farms, ERA5 and GEBCO arrays
missing_information_and_declared_complet.completion: map roles A-G to official cited-lineage sites D-J; role H uses an independently offset seed and macro-cell role on site I because only seven public fields support 100 turbines at 1.2 km spacing; preserve target coordinates/regions and emit every proxy identity
deterministically retain the official legal point nearest each 800 m cell centre
use 15 km, the paper-tested upper end of its 2.5 to 15 km interval, because the declared legal proxy fields contain separated obstacle components that stall at 5 km

missing_information_and_declared_complet.field: macro orientation, ratio and local-cell sets
missing_information_and_declared_complet.completion: six 30-degree orientations, ratios 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5 and 2, and a 3 by 3 local 4 km-cell screen

missing_information_and_declared_complet.field: greedy construction dead ends on proxy obstacle components
missing_information_and_declared_complet.completion: use the best feasible macro layout only as a completion certificate; admit a meso candidate only when enough mutually compatible reserve positions remain to reach 100 turbines, without forcing the final shape to equal the rectangle

use published cable costs, official foundation costs, minimum-spanning-tree cable length, a fixed latitude-role export distance and one layout-independent per-seed offset calibrated only to the published rectangle NPV
use the mean 288 EUR/m during T83 layout optimization; exact capacity-six routing remains available in T33 and is not claimed as T83 target detail

formal_protocol.repeat_count: the paper reports one result per seed and does not report independent repeats
formal_protocol.resource_rule: one seed run owns every Waffle core; the constructed-shape and rectangle micro searches execute sequentially
metrics: NPV, AEP, foundation, inter-array and export cable costs
area, perimeter, PtA, density, spacing and all violations
macro rectangle count, pair construction, meso and micro candidate counts
phase runtimes, worker receipt, source fingerprint and scientific hash

hpc.executor: one persistent all-core team per problem construction and optimization
mathematical_reformulations: precompute immutable fixed-farm wake contribution for every legal candidate
compress the linearized Jensen layout objective to diagonal free energy plus a packed symmetric pair matrix
update meso candidate marginal energy by one pair column after every ordered turbine commit
evaluate all turbine-slot micro neighborhoods in parallel and use O(N) pair deltas rather than full wake recomputation
reuse one immutable legal geometry and pair matrix across both micro shape roles
retain only fixed-index parallel writes, stable comparisons and ordered state commits
hpc.adaptive_granularity: small delta sets execute in the caller; the expensive slot-candidate enumeration and sufficiently large delta sets use every worker
hpc.determinism: counter-keyed events and ordered macro, meso, VNS and incumbent commits preserve fixed-work one/all-worker identity

claim_boundary: Academic flexible reconstruction of the complete three-scale method and eight paper roles using an explicit same-lineage offshore proxy; not author code, exact UK arrays, target layouts, random stream or numerical optimum replay.
